sources.snippet: That is the framing of this experiment. We take the recurrent-depth structure suggested by OpenMythos and integrate the same high-level idea into a small DeepSeek-V4-style model family, referred to here as NanoMythos. The experiment then evaluates whether a single recurrent step, T=1, can improve language-modeling perplexity on FineWeb-Edu.
